visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A waitress wearing a white face mask and a light beige collared uniform carries a massive, tower-like fruit parfait in a giant martini glass. The parfait is decorated with mango chunks, white cream, and red ribbons. A young man with black hair and glasses is seated at a red-topped table in a brightly lit restaurant with red curtains and globe lights in the background. (2) Close-up shots highlight the parfait's composition: layers of bright yellow mango, dark blueberries, white whipped cream, and cubes of honey toast. The man points toward the dessert while speaking, his facial expressions animated and engaging. (3) The man puts on transparent plastic gloves and begins the eating challenge. A digital timer overlay appears in the top right corner. He uses a large spoon to scoop out large portions of fruit and cream, occasionally standing up or leaning in close to the glass. (4) Rapid cuts show the man consuming different layers of the dessert, including ice cream and jam. His mouth is frequently full, and he exhibits a focused, determined expression. The background remains a busy restaurant with other patrons visible at tables. (5) The man finishes the challenge, showing the nearly empty giant glass to the waitress. He smiles and gestures with a spoon. A cartoon bear graphic with the text '挑戰成功' (Challenge Successful) appears on the screen as he interacts with the staff.
